uncertain: The legend labels 'High' at the top (value 100) and 'Low' at the bottom (value 0) are spatially inverted relative to the standard convention where dark red typically indicates high values.

The map displays a single state (NH) and the queried option state (UT) in the same darkest color category, making it impossible to distinguish which has the absolute highest incidence based on visual shading alone.
